North Dakota Recorders Information Network -
To preserve and protect North Dakota land records for future generations.
Welcome to the world of NDRIN ( N orth D akota R ecorders I nformation N etwork). A group of North Dakota counties have joined together to extend the application of the 1999 disaster-proofing FEMA grant and provide access to real estate records via the Internet. These records have previously been available only through books and microfilm in the Recorder's offices in the county courthouses.
To ensure the information you are looking for is available, check the county information pages on the interactive map, under ND Recorders.
